title: The WhataHotel Take: Four Seasons Maui at Wailea

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Four Seasons Maui at Wailea is a Forbes Five-Star resort. The thing to understand right now? It's mid-transformation.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Which cuts both ways. Start with the good.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: The setting. It's an eight-storey U-shaped building, so most rooms face the Pacific. And Wailea Beach is number four on Dr. Beach's 2026 list of best US beaches.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Three saline pools, including the adults-only Serenity Pool, infinity-edge with underwater music. Kai Holo Spa has hydrotherapy pools and infrared saunas. And KOMO's fourteen-seat sushi bar, under Chef Kiyokuni Ikeda, is a real draw.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Couples, beach lovers, and families with kids five and up. Kids For All Seasons is complimentary, nine to five daily. Winter's special too: humpbacks usually peak January to March.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Here's my caution. The guest-room renovation isn't finished. Refreshed rooms debut in Q4 2026, so an autumn stay may coincide with construction. Confirm room status when you book.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Fair. And entry-level rooms are mountain-side, so ocean views mean a higher category.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Also, the beach is public, and you reach it through the lobby and pool areas.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Bottom line: great for couples and families wanting a polished beach resort. Just confirm which room you're getting.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, free Wi-Fi, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, a $100 hotel credit, among other perks.

short_version.best_for: Couples, beach lovers and families with kids 5 and up
short_version.atmosphere: Full-service Forbes Five-Star oceanfront resort on Wailea Beach
short_version.worth_knowing: Room renovation ongoing; refreshed rooms debut Q4 2026, so confirm room status
